record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Does there exist a weakly mixing polygonal billiard; in particular, are Vorobets' billiards weakly mixing?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 31 (A. Katok) . Does there exist a weakly mixing polygonal billiard? Speciﬁcally, are Vorobets’ billiards [253] weakly mixing?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the billiard flow in a planar polygon $P$: a point particle moves at unit speed inside $P$ along straight lines and reflects elastically (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection) at the boundary. The phase space is the unit tangent bundle of $P$ (with directions identified at the boundary by the reflection law), equipped with the Liouville measure (the product of Lebesgue measure on $P$ and the uniform measure on directions), which is invariant under the flow. The flow is said to be weakly mixing if it has continuous spectrum on the orthogonal complement of the constants in $L^2$ of the Liouville measure.

(a) Does there exist a polygon $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ whose billiard flow is weakly mixing with respect to the Liouville measure?

(b) In particular, are the "Vorobets billiards" — polygons constructed as fast Liouville-type approximations by rational polygons designed to produce strong ergodic behavior — weakly mixing?
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a) was answered affirmatively: it has been proved that there exists a residual (dense G-delta) set of non-rational polygons whose billiard flow is weakly mixing with respect to the Liouville measure (Chaika–Forni, "Weakly Mixing Polygonal Billiards", arXiv:2003.00890, 2020). However, whether the specific Vorobets billiards are weakly mixing does not appear to be settled in the literature, so part (b) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Mixing Polygonal Billiards (Chaika–Forni)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove that there exists a residual set of (non-rational) polygons such the billiard flow is weakly mixing with respect to the Liouville measure.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of weakly mixing polygonal billiards is established for a residual set of polygons.

status_evidence.title: Weak mixing in rational billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of rational polygons with weakly mixing billiard flow in a.e. direction, proving a conjecture of Gutkin.
status_evidence.claim: Further progress on weak mixing in the rational case, but does not specifically address Vorobets' constructions.
